rationale: Both Prakash and Ben are San Francisco-based founders building in complementary spaces—Prakash has deep full-stack web development expertise (JavaScript, TypeScript, React) and experience shipping practical applications, while Ben is working in robotics and AI. Prakash's background in UX/UI and streaming solutions could inform how Ben's robotics work interfaces with users, and Ben's domain expertise could open new technical directions for Prakash's next project.
intro_message: Prakash, meet Ben Holfeld — he's building SF Agents & Robots and your full-stack web chops plus UX focus could be valuable as robotics products need solid interfaces.
